text: You just dropped a frozen turkey into a deep fryer.
The ice inside hits oil that's three hundred fifty degrees.
It turns to steam instantly, and the oil boils up over the edge.
It pours onto the flame underneath, and the whole fryer goes up.
Thaw it all the way first. That's about one day in the fridge for every five pounds.
Then turn the flame off, and lower it in slowly.
Always fry outside, far from the house, and never put water on it.
Tag whoever's frying the turkey this year, and subscribe.
